sql_query: WITH supplier_spend AS (SELECT su.supplier_id, su.supplier_name, SUM(sl.amount) AS total_spend FROM spend_lines AS sl JOIN suppliers AS su ON su.supplier_id = sl.supplier_id JOIN categories AS c ON c.category_id = sl.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Facilities' AND sl.status = 'posted' AND sl.currency_code = 'GBP' AND sl.posting_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND sl.posting_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY su.supplier_id, su.supplier_name), category_total AS (SELECT SUM(total_spend) AS total_spend FROM supplier_spend) SELECT ss.supplier_name, ss.total_spend, ROUND(100.0 * ss.total_spend / NULLIF(ct.total_spend, 0), 2) AS spend_share_pct FROM supplier_spend AS ss CROSS JOIN category_total AS ct ORDER BY ss.total_spend DESC, ss.supplier_name ASC LIMIT 10;

sql_query: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sl.posting_date)::integer AS year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM sl.posting_date)::integer AS quarter, cc.cost_center_name, SUM(sl.amount) AS total_spend FROM spend_lines AS sl JOIN cost_centers AS cc ON cc.cost_center_id = sl.cost_center_id WHERE sl.status = 'posted' AND sl.currency_code = 'EUR' AND sl.posting_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND sl.posting_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sl.posting_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM sl.posting_date), cc.cost_center_id, cc.cost_center_name ORDER BY year ASC, quarter ASC, cc.cost_center_name ASC;
